name: Twilio SMS
description: Send SMS through Twilio's Messages API. Admin-editable credentials and sender, plus a test-text button. A capability for core and other services: answers the sms.send hook

setup.postInstallNote: Disabled by default. Enter the Account SID, Auth Token and a sender (a Twilio number, an alphanumeric sender ID, or a Messaging Service SID) on the Twilio SMS settings page, press Send test text, then switch on Send SMS through Twilio. This service only sends; whatever wants to text (core or another service) calls the sms.send hook.
